apply_bpe_to_code_string: apply BPE tokenization using RoBERTa to a source code string and return tokenized output
apply_bpe_to_file: apply BPE tokenization using RoBERTa to a source code file and write tokenized output to a new file
repair_bpe_for_obfuscation_line: repair a single line of BPE tokenized text to fix obfuscated identifiers like CLASS_ FUNC_ and VAR_
repair_bpe_for_obfuscation_file: repair an entire file of BPE tokenized text to fix obfuscated identifiers and special tokens
initialize_roberta_bpe_mode: initialize a RobertaBPEMode instance that uses pretrained RoBERTa vocabulary for BPE tokenization
